skaffys-api.options.vista.tooltip: Skaffy's API's own shader: soft shadows, colored light, reflections, clouds and more. Works in single player and on any server; servers can turn it on or off for you while you play there.
skaffys-api.options.shaderDistance.toolt: How far shadows, colored light and other shader effects reach, for Vista and servers' shaders. Lower is faster. Never further than your Render Distance.
skaffys-api.options.locked: Locked by the server you're playing on
